properties.name: The done check reads "design done" separately from "build done" — a design can close before anything is built, on estimates marked as such, while build done needs built work and measurements
properties.source: Anthony, 2026-09-29, in the dev_reflow2 hub session, relayed by the hub agent: "Fix all the root causes and go with the 7 ideas you'd promote". This is idea 5, dec:idea-closure-has-a-design-phase-reading-and-a-build-phase-reading.
properties.statement:
closure_report gives a DESIGN-PHASE reading and a BUILD-PHASE reading.

In the design phase:
- traceability counts a requirement as closed when it is satisfied by an allocated capability with a planned check, not only when delivered;
- a budget closes on an estimate that carries its basis;
- parked items count as parked, not as holes.

Build done keeps today's meaning: delivered, checked, and measured.

Counter-argument kept: "design done" gets quoted as "done". So every reading names its phase, and the build reading is never replaced.

Found by the two-agent exercise (I15): the owner's criterion "design done may close on asserted estimates; build done needs measurements" could not be computed. Traceability read 0/7 before any code existed, seams and decisions read null, and a parked requirement read as a hole.
